title: ButtonBadge
description: A numeric count or attention dot in a Fiori Button badge slot.

usage.summary: Show a count or attract attention on an existing action.
useWhen: Show a count inline in compact density, overlay a count in cozy density, or draw attention with a dot in either density.
Use a count for the number of relevant items or an attention dot to indicate activity without a count.

avoidWhen.when: Trigger an action that needs no count or attention indicator.
Label a standalone category or status outside an action.
